top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock (Katori, Ye) is the best-attributed and independently confirmed achievement on the slate, and the magic-wavelength ensemble idea is distinct from the 2005 and 2012 prizes. Paired with IceCube's discovery of the diffuse high-energy astrophysical neutrino flux, it adds a discovery-type part that a measurement-only prize lacks; the one-name IceCube credit is the weak point, so the clock alone (P001) is my close second.
